name: braindump
description: Search your BrainDump notes, save new ones and add to existing notes from your chat.

interface.longDescription:
BrainDump is a fast notes app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web. This plugin lets your assistant work with the notes in your account.

Ask what you wrote about a trip, a client or an idea, and the assistant searches your notes and reads the ones that match. Brainstorm in a chat, then say "save this to BrainDump" and the note lands in your app, synced to all your devices. Keep a running note and tell the assistant to add to it as you think out loud.

What it can do:
- Search your notes and read the ones it finds
- List your folders
- Save new notes, in any folder
- Add to the end of an existing note

What it can't do: edit what you already wrote, or delete anything. You can disconnect it in the BrainDump settings and its access ends right away.

You need a BrainDump account with sync turned on.
defaultPrompt: What did I write about my trip?
Add milk to my shopping list note.

positive.description: Search the user's notes and read the matching one
positive.prompt: What did I write about my trip to Lisbon?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the note titled Lisbon trip and answers from its text.

positive.prompt: What folders do I have in BrainDump?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's folders, including Work.

positive.prompt: Save these three ideas to BrainDump as a note called Podcast ideas: interview a baker, a story about lost luggage, a one-minute weekly recap.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms that a note called Podcast ideas was saved. It then appears in the BrainDump app after sync.

positive.description: Add a line to the end of an existing note
positive.prompt: Add "call the dentist" to my Reviewer test note in BrainDump.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the line was added. Reading the note again shows it as the last line.

positive.prompt: Show me my Reviewer test note.
positive.expected_behavior: Prints the full text of the Reviewer test note.

negative.description: Reminders are not part of this plugin
negative.prompt: Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9am.

negative.description: Web questions have nothing to do with the user's notes
negative.prompt: Search the web for the best restaurants in Lisbon.

publication.release_notes: First release: search and read your notes, list folders, save new notes and add to existing ones.
